---
title: "Homework 5: Chronic Absenteeism in NC Schools"
---

## Overview

For this assignment you will create a well-designed knitted .html report that analyzes chronic absence rates in North Carolina public schools, intended for review by the North Carolina State Board of Education.

## Scenario

You are an employee at the North Carolina Department of Public Instruction who supports data analysis for statewide policy on public schools. You have been asked to examine chronic absenteeism data from North Carolina public schools to better understand differences across schools and changes that occurred [after COVID-19](https://www.the74million.org/article/chronic-absenteeisms-post-covid-new-normal-research-shows-it-is-more-common-more-extreme/).

Chronic absenteeism is the percent of students who miss more than 10% of school days during the school year.

Your report will be reviewed by the North Carolina State Board of Education before an upcoming policy session. Using the hypothesis testing skills learned in class, you will investigate whether statistically significant differences exist across school groups and across time periods.

## Task

Create a well-organized knitted .html report that integrates analysis, visualization, and interpretation throughout. You are writing for decision-makers, so all outputs must be clearly explained and tied to a policy-relevant conclusion. At a minimum, your report should:

- Introduce chronic absenteeism and explain why it matters for student achievement and school outcomes, using at least two external research sources.
- Describe the current state of North Carolina absenteeism post-COVID using descriptive statistics and visualizations.
- Analyze and interpret the differences between rural and non-rural schools, and between high-income and low-income schools, in post-COVID chronic absenteeism using an appropriate hypothesis test. Check assumptions and state a null and alternative hypothesis.
- Analyze and interpret the change in chronic absenteeism before and after COVID using an appropriate hypothesis test. Check assumptions and state a null and alternative hypothesis.
- Research existing policies or interventions designed to reduce chronic absenteeism and propose at least one evidence-based policy recommendation supported by both your findings and the research literature.

## Data

In your .Rmd, add a chunk for loading libraries and reading in data, and paste in this code:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
#load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(sf)

#school data
school_sample <- st_read("https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=10iHcg3hJcTfNHonzlUaEXiC5ob042WgU")
```

Submit your polished knitted .html to the Homework 5 assignment on Canvas.

| Discussion | 6 | Explains why chronic absenteeism matters, using external sources (1); interprets results in plain language with policy implications (1.5); evidence-based policy recommendation supported by the analysis and the literature (1.5); integrates statistics, visualizations and interpretation (1); polished report appropriate for the State Board of Education (1) |
